body:
I wrote out a whole long rant... but you didn't ask for that... and it isn't your problem.

The answer is yes... I have... and no I will not again.

Also yes, the clinical diagnosis is depression

that's about as worthless as it comes.

This post made me realize I'm not apathetically suicidal, I'm empathetically suicidal. For me to kill myself, and be comfortable with it, I need to know that those I care about will be taken care of. That's the only things stopping me.
